C1767.title: Mass-Scale Cache Poisoning Vulnerability Discovery
C1767.summary: In February 2022, security researcher Youstin discovered over 70 cache poisoning vulnerabilities across multiple bug bounty programs using techniques such as cache key confusion and header poisoning. The attacks involved Apache Traffic Server's mishandling of URL fragments (CVE-2021-27577), redirect loops caused by the X-Forwarded-Scheme header, and exploitation of misconfigurations in Cloudflare
